dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Of course. The cannon is still in the design phase.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I am also looking into the materials we'll need to make that cannon. They need to be sufficiently hard and heat-resistant...

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Or our cannon would get off one shot, then "boom," it'd be a goner.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: I'm even considering placing the cannon in the shallows, or perhaps directly in water! That way, it should be easier to cool off, and we can transport cannonballs by water. Truly, nothing but benefits from doing so!

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Of course, I'll have to solve the problem of forging the cannon itself first...
